- Parse the input string to a decimal-friendly type (e.g., Decimal) to avoid float precision issues; handle optional sign, integer and fractional parts, and validate numeric format.
- Compute the nearest integer by separating the integer part and fractional magnitude: if abs(fraction) < 0.5, return toward zero; if > 0.5, return away from zero; if exactly 0.5, return away from zero (i.e., add/subtract 1 based on sign).
- Ensure correct handling of edge cases: pure integers, trailing/leading zeros, negative values, large numbers, and values like "x.500...0"; raise or handle invalid inputs gracefully if non-numeric.
